gloss: grove of trees; stand of trees

definitions.gloss: grove of trees; stand of trees; clump of trees
definitions.explanation: A group of trees standing together. Evokes a picturesque, somewhat literary image of trees clustered in a landscape.

examples.japanese: {木立|こだち}の{中|なか}を{歩|ある}く。
{木立|こだち}の{間|あいだ}から{光|ひかり}が{差|さ}し{込|こ}む。
examples.english: Light streams in through the trees.

examples.japanese: {静|しず}かな{木立|こだち}に{囲|かこ}まれた{小|ちい}さな{家|いえ}が{見|み}えた。
examples.english: A small house surrounded by a quiet grove of trees came into view.

notes:
Composed of {木|こ} (tree, an older form of {木|き}) + {立|だち} (standing). Has a literary, scenic quality and frequently appears in descriptions of landscapes, gardens, and rural settings. Unlike {森|もり} (forest), {木立|こだち} suggests a smaller, more open cluster of trees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木立|こだち}の{中|なか} — among the trees
- {木立|こだち}の{影|かげ} — the shade of the trees
- {木立|こだち}に{囲|かこ}まれた — surrounded by a grove of trees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {林|はやし} — woods; a smaller area of trees than a forest
- {森|もり} — forest; a larger, denser area of trees
- {並木|なみき} — row of trees; trees planted in a line along a road
